data.one_liner: Flutter widget for rendering QR codes with optional image overlay.
data.what_it_does: Provides a fast, null‑safe widget and custom painter to generate QR codes directly in Flutter. Supports configurable size, colors, error correction, and embedded images without requiring network access.
use_when: You need to display QR codes in a Flutter UI
You want customizable QR appearance or embed a logo/image
avoid_when: You need to scan QR codes (use a camera package)
You require server‑side QR generation or advanced encoding features
strengths: Highly customizable (size, colors, eye style, embedded image)
No external dependencies beyond qr package
weaknesses: Only renders QR codes, no scanning capability
Limited to features provided by the underlying qr.dart library
No built‑in caching or image export beyond raw data
